content:
We need DBE for C9H9O5Cl. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (halogens count as H). No N. Halogen Cl counts as H. So effective H = H + halogens = 9 +1 =10. DBE = C - (H_eff)/2 +1 = 9 - 10/2 +1 = 9 -5 +1 =5. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we know. Could call retrieve_dbe_formula just to be safe.
